_why: This showcase shows real mistakes that AI picture tools make, next to the fixed version, so anyone can see what this repository is for in ten seconds.
_how: Make a new case with: node scripts/showcase.mjs --new <short-name>. That makes a folder in showcase/cases/ with a copy of this file in it, named case.json. Put two pictures in that folder: before.png (the mistake) and after.png (the fix). A .jpg, .jpeg, .webp or .svg works too. Replace every sentence below with your own words. Then run node scripts/showcase.mjs --check to test it, and node scripts/showcase.mjs to rebuild the gallery. Optional: before_label and after_label change the captions under the pictures (the default is "Before: the mistake" and "After: the fix"); use them when that is not the true story of the pair. No code changes are needed.
_rules: Keep every path short and relative, like before.png. Never write a path from your own computer. Never name a character: write CHARACTER 1 or a {{token}}. Never call a drawing or a placeholder a real picture: say which one it is in evidence.
title: Short descriptive title of the fix (e.g. Phantom Hoodie vs. Attached Cowl)
what_broke: Explain in simple 8th-grade English what the AI got wrong when prompted normally.
how_fixed: Explain in simple 8th-grade English which SSOT layer, token, or gate physically prevented the mistake.
before_prompt: The naive or unguarded prompt that caused the drift
after_prompt: The compiled SSOT prompt with explicit layers and negative tokens
